title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 05:13:22 最新章节：第701章 再次背锅的方师兄
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
穿越来到这个世界也快有十八年了，进入这个宗门也有五年了，龙涛终于在昨天从杂役熬成了外门弟子，所以颇为兴奋。
这些年里，他没有奇遇，没有系统金手指，没有前辈高人传功，甚至连最低级的引气诀都练得磕磕绊绊，至今还在练气五层徘徊。
“果然，穿越者不一定都是主角……”
他曾经也幻想过自己是不是某个大能转世，或者身怀绝世灵宝，只是尚未觉醒。
但现实很快给了他一巴掌，他就是个普通人，不过比大部分普通人略好的是，他在这个世界的父母颇有家资，硬是靠钱财和过去的人脉，给他弄进了九霞天宗这个顶级大宗门。
其实他对现状也挺满意，要知道...一个大宗门的外门弟子，在凡俗世界已经是相当有身份了，虽不至于被一般家族当成座上宾，但也无人敢轻易怠慢。
他甚至已经做好了在这个世界的人生规划，等将来慢慢熬到筑基，就和宗门申请外放，回老家找个离家近的小家族当个长老或客卿，攒够了积蓄就找个练气期的漂亮姑娘共度一生，堪称完美。
就在他换好新领到的外门弟子服饰，准备去藏书阁看看时，脑海里突然传来了一道声音。
“寰宇气运所钟，天命之子选定，检测到适配宿主，天命气运辅助系统已绑定。”
那声音恢宏庄严，恍若自九天而落，带着一种不容置疑、近乎法则般的宿命威压，骤然穿透他的识海。
龙涛身形猛地一僵，正准备迈出的脚步停滞在半空。
幻听？
不......这声音太清晰真实，绝非臆想。
莫非是五年苦修，终于生了心魔？不可能啊，自己一个练气期的垃圾，也不值得心魔惦记啊。
他心脏骤然收紧，下意识地四下环顾。
确定那声音并非来自外面，而是直接在他脑海中响起。
难道真是...系统？！
或者换个说法...金手指！
外挂！
巨大的荒谬感和狂喜如同冰火两重天，在他心中剧烈冲撞。

指尖无法控制地轻颤起来，他几乎要怀疑自己是否在某个漫长的梦境里未曾醒来。
终于来了！
我难道真的是主角？！
五年！
整整五年！
在他准备老老实实攒钱回老家娶个姑娘过小日子的时候，终于等到了自己的外挂！
美女师尊，宗门圣女，皇朝公主，都给我洗干净等着吧！
“我就知道！
穿越者怎么会是普通人！”
龙涛激动得语无伦次，“系统！
content_en:
It has been almost eighteen years since he traveled to this world and five years since he entered this sect. Yesterday, Long Tao finally became an outer disciple from a handyman, so he was quite excited.
Over the years, he has had no adventures, no golden fingers of the system, no senior masters to teach him skills, and even the lowest level of Qi Entraining Technique has been stumbling in practice, and he is still at the fifth level of Qi training.
"Sure enough, time travelers are not necessarily the protagonists..."
He had also imagined that he was the reincarnation of some great power, or that he possessed a peerless spiritual treasure, but he had not yet awakened.
But reality soon slapped him in the face. He was just an ordinary person, but what was slightly better than most ordinary people was that his parents in this world were quite wealthy. They relied on money and past connections to get him into the top sect of Jiuxia Tianzong.
In fact, he is quite satisfied with the current situation. You know... an outer disciple of a large sect is already quite well-known in the mortal world. Although he is not regarded as a guest by ordinary families, no one dares to neglect him easily.
He has even made a plan for his life in this world. When he slowly builds his foundation in the future, he will apply with his sect for release, return to his hometown to find a small family close to home to be an elder or a guest, and after saving enough, he will find a beautiful girl in the Qi training period to spend his life with. It is perfect.
Just when he was changing into the newly received outer disciple clothes and preparing to go to the library to take a look, a voice suddenly came from his mind.
"The fate of the world is clocked, the son of destiny is selected, the adaptable host is detected, and the destiny auxiliary system is bound."
The voice was majestic and solemn, as if it had fallen from the sky, and with an unquestionable, almost law-like pressure of fate, it suddenly penetrated his sea of consciousness.
Long Tao's body suddenly stiffened, and the steps he was about to take stopped in mid-air.
Auditory hallucinations?
No... this voice is too clear and real, it is definitely not a figment.
Could it be that five years of hard training finally gave birth to inner demons? It's impossible. I'm a piece of trash in my Qi training period, and I'm not worth worrying about.
His heart suddenly tightened and he looked around subconsciously.
He was sure that the voice did not come from outside, but sounded directly in his mind.
Is it really... a system? !
Or to put it another way...Goldfinger!
Plug-in!
The huge sense of absurdity and ecstasy were like two heavens of ice and fire, colliding violently in his heart.
His fingertips trembled uncontrollably, and he almost wondered if he had never woken up from a long dream.
It’s finally here!
Am I really the protagonist? !
Five years!
Five whole years!
When he was preparing to save money to return to his hometown to marry a girl and live a happy life, he finally got his cheat!
Beautiful master, sect saint, dynasty princess, please wash them all and wait for me!
"I knew it!
How could the time traveler be an ordinary person! "
Long Tao was so excited that he couldn't speak coherently, "System!
